description: Managed device driver for Projectors that support PJ Link protocol.
author: symetrix

notes: New standard panel: PJLink header, stock Cognio controls.
Connect Offline replaces the Connect, Disconnect and Auto-Connect buttons: online the driver always connects; offline it connects only while Connect Offline is on.
Connected lights only after the projector answers, and a projector that stops answering is dropped and retried.
